title: Koszul objects represent cohomology on principal opens
statement: Intermediate representability conjunction: inverse augmentations and the colimit cocone clauses of lem-sc-affine-perfect-open-represent-cohomology.

proof.text: Use the principal-unit lemma at exponent e+1. Identify its basic-open union with koszulOpen. Transport IsIso through the derived functor composition isomorphism, and take the canonical inverse v_e, with both inverse identities.

The structural compatibility of power transitions with augmentation implies v_b followed by the restricted power transition equals v_a, by insertion of the two inverse identities. Construct the cocone explicitly by phi mapping to v_e followed by restriction(phi); functoriality and this compatibility prove naturality.

Finite-stage restriction surjectivity gives joint surjectivity of the cocone legs. Equality of two legs at one stage gives equality of restricted morphisms after composition with the augmentation. Apply eventual restriction-zero vanishing to their difference and use bilinearity to obtain equality at a later stage. Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' gives the colimit witness. Assemble v, both inverse identities, the explicit cocone formula, and that witness.
